fiction.title: THE CALAMITY CLUB
fiction.author: Kathryn Stockett
fiction.description: As things get tougher during the Depression, several women look for ways to improve their circumstances.

fiction.title: YESTERYEAR
fiction.author: Caro Claire Burke
fiction.description: Natalie Heller Mills, a privileged tradwife social media influencer, wakes up to find she is living in the comparatively difficult reality of 1855.

fiction.title: THE BUTCHER LEGACY
fiction.author: Alaina Urquhart
fiction.description: The third book in the Dr. Wren Muller series. Wren and Leroux get back to work as young girls vanish in two cities.

fiction.title: WHISTLER
fiction.author: Ann Patchett
fiction.description: Decades after their time together, a woman reconnects with her stepfather and they look back at the directions their lives have taken.

fiction.title: THE SECRETS WE HIDE
fiction.author: Karin Slaughter
fiction.description: The second book in the North Falls thriller series. Sheriff Emmy Clifton investigates a crime in which a mother was murdered and her daughter left for dead.

nonfiction.title: REGIME CHANGE
nonfiction.author: Maggie Haberman and Jonathan Swan
nonfiction.description: Two White House correspondents for The New York Times delve into the first year of President Trump's second term.

nonfiction.title: THE DAY AFTER
nonfiction.author: Brian Tyler Cohen
nonfiction.description: The author of “Shameless” looks at the relationship Republicans and Democrats have to power and prescribes ways for it to be used after Donald Trump’s presidency.

nonfiction.title: STRANGERS
nonfiction.author: Belle Burden
nonfiction.description: Burden retraces her marriage of 20 years in search of clues to help shape her understanding about its demise and to find a way forward.

nonfiction.title: DOGS, BOYS, AND OTHER THINGS I'VE CRIED ABOUT
nonfiction.author: Isabel Klee
nonfiction.description: Klee helps foster dogs overcome challenges while she faces her own complications.

nonfiction.title: LONDON FALLING
nonfiction.author: Patrick Radden Keefe
nonfiction.description: The author of “Say Nothing” details the efforts by the parents of a 19-year-old Londoner to uncover the truth about his mysterious death and secret life.
